interpretation.gainSign: The harness reports current minus variant. Negate revertBoth gain to report savings from the shipped change.
interpretation.frameStatistic: Mean across six per-phase median RAF intervals; paired mean difference. Dispersion is max minus min of paired differences.
interpretation.coverage: Geometric terrain-only raster estimate over the entire canvas; no prop, avatar, ocean, cloud, atmosphere or UI occlusion. Not fragment invocation counts.
interpretation.flight: Six-second camera route at nominal 55 m/s along a great circle at 80 m above sampled terrain. Streaming is active; geometry is not held identical. Coverage is recorded at the start and end, not averaged along the route.
